papers.abstract: Abstract ReaDy accelerates autoregressive generation by using hybrid linear attention recurrent states to retrieve position-specific context for speculative drafting, improving speed and acceptance rates.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Speculative decoding accelerates autoregressive generation by drafting multiple tokens per step, yet feature-based drafters rely on target hidden features whose contextual emphasis may not align with the needs of subsequent draft positions. Hybrid linear attention (HLA) models maintain compact recurrent states that accumulate historical associations, offering an efficient source of complementary context for speculative drafting. We introduce ReaDy, the first speculative decoding method, to the best of our knowledge, to leverage HLA recurrent states for position-specific context retrieval during drafting. ReaDy equips each draft position with a learned query to retrieve supplementary context directly from the target's committed recurrent states. A lightweight state reader integrates this context into draft representations through residual updates, while low-rank state reads and fused operators keep additional computation and I/O overhead low. Building on DSpark's parallel backbone and sequential prediction head, ReaDy employs a lightweight two-stage adaptation strategy, with reader capacity, state sources, and residual placement examined through ablation studies. Across seven benchmarks spanning mathematics, code generation, and dialogue, ReaDy achieves an average 3.16times decoding speedup over autoregressive decoding with Qwen3.8-27B on a single NVIDIA B200 GPU. It outperforms DSpark on every benchmark, improving throughput by 7.97% and acceptance length by 8.50% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/StartLuxLabs/ReaDy.
affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

ru.title: Память рекуррентных состояний ускоряет генерацию текста
ru.desc: Статья предлагает ReaDy — метод спекулятивного декодирования, который ускоряет авторегрессионную генерацию LLM. Для каждой позиции черновика обучаемый запрос извлекает дополнительный контекст из рекуррентных состояний hybrid linear attention (HLA) целевой модели. Лёгкий state reader встраивает этот контекст в представления драфтера через residual-обновления, а low-rank чтения состояний снижают накладные расходы. На семи бенчмарках метод даёт в среднем ускорение декодирования в 3.16 раза и опережает DSpark по пропускной способности и длине принятых токенов.

en.title: Accelerating Autoregressive Generation with ReaDy
en.desc: ReaDy is a novel method that enhances the speed of autoregressive generation in machine learning by utilizing hybrid linear attention (HLA) to retrieve context specific to each position during speculative drafting. This approach allows for the generation of multiple tokens at once, improving efficiency while maintaining the relevance of the context used for each draft position. By integrating learned queries with compact recurrent states, ReaDy effectively accumulates historical information, which aids in generating more coherent outputs. The method demonstrates significant performance improvements across various benchmarks, achieving faster decoding and higher acceptance rates compared to existing models.

zh.title: ReaDy：加速自回归生成的新方法
zh.desc: ReaDy是一种加速自回归生成的方法，它利用混合线性注意力的递归状态来检索特定位置的上下文，从而提高生成速度和接受率。该方法通过每一步生成多个标记来加快自回归生成，但传统的特征基础生成器可能无法满足后续草稿位置的上下文需求。ReaDy通过学习查询来直接从目标的递归状态中检索补充上下文，并通过残差更新将这些上下文整合到草稿表示中。经过多项基准测试，ReaDy在解码速度上比传统自回归解码快3.16倍，并在各项指标上超越了DSpark。

papers.title: StopWatch: Goal Grounding for Object-goal Navigation
papers.abstract: Abstract Explicit goal grounding fixes the dominant failure in vision-language navigation policies, yielding near-expert success with minimal policy changes.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Pretrained VLMs bring rich world knowledge and semantic priors to object-goal navigation, and fine-tuning a VLM into a navigation policy has become a common recipe. Despite this progress, success rates remain low, and it is unclear which capability these fine-tuned policies lack. Our diagnosis identifies goal grounding as the dominant failure. These policies explore well, yet often fail to notice that the goal is already in view or to estimate how far away it is. To address this failure, we ground the goal explicitly. Explicit grounding substantially improves success and reaches state-of-the-art results on six benchmarks across three scene collections. We also correct annotation defects in these benchmarks, so that future methods are evaluated more faithfully. Our analysis on the clean benchmarks shows that, with ground-truth grounding, our policy nearly matches the expert that generated its demonstrations, leaving the headroom in perception rather than policy learning. Our work points to goal grounding as a missing piece of object-goal navigation and offers a simple and effective solution to the task.

ru.title: Найти цель важнее, чем исследовать: явное заземление делает навигацию точной
ru.desc: Авторы статьи выявили, что главная причина низкой успешности VLM-политик для навигации к цели (object-goal navigation) заключается в плохом grounding цели: агент хорошо исследует пространство, но не замечает, что цель уже в поле зрения, и не оценивает расстояние до неё. Чтобы решить эту проблему, предлагается явно заземлять цель, что значительно повышает success rate и даёт state-of-the-art результаты на шести бенчмарках. Авторы также исправили ошибки в разметке этих бенчмарков, чтобы будущие методы оценивались честнее. Анализ с ground-truth grounding показал, что политика почти сравнивается с экспертом, генерировавшим демонстрации, а значит, основной резерв улучшений лежит в восприятии, а не в обучении политики.

en.title: Enhancing Navigation Success through Explicit Goal Grounding
en.desc: This paper addresses a significant issue in vision-language navigation policies, specifically the failure of goal grounding. The authors demonstrate that while fine-tuned vision-language models (VLMs) can navigate well, they often struggle to recognize when a goal is in sight or to gauge its distance. By implementing explicit goal grounding, the researchers significantly enhance the success rates of navigation tasks, achieving state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks. Their findings suggest that improving goal grounding is crucial for advancing object-goal navigation capabilities.

zh.title: 明确目标定位，提升导航成功率
zh.desc: 本文探讨了视觉-语言导航策略中的目标定位问题，指出这是导致成功率低的主要原因。通过明确的目标定位，研究者们显著提高了导航策略的成功率，并在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的结果。尽管现有的策略在探索方面表现良好，但它们常常无法识别目标是否在视野内或估计目标的距离。本文的研究表明，明确的目标定位是物体目标导航中缺失的重要环节，并提供了简单有效的解决方案。

papers.title: Persistent Planar Memory for Video World Models
papers.abstract: Abstract PPMem is a video world model that uses compact plane primitives as persistent 3D memory to generate long coherent videos with explicit metric geometry.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Video world models that generate and explore environments at scale need a persistent 3D memory of what they have produced. Plane primitives offer a natural candidate: a compact set of oriented planes captures the dominant structural elements (e.g., walls, floors, facades) of indoor and outdoor scenes, while requiring only 7 parameters per primitive. We present PPMem, a video world model that adopts plane primitives as its persistent 3D memory. PPMem augments a video diffusion transformer with a planar prediction head and a Depth Token Fusion (DTF) module: each autoregressive chunk jointly produces RGB video and planar geometry, which merges into a persistent plane memory that conditions subsequent chunks via rendered depth. The resulting memory is three orders of magnitude more compact than per-pixel point clouds (~100K primitives, 5MB for a full scene), geometrically explicit (metric depth, normals, exportable surfaces), cross-view consistent (jointly predicted by the shared backbone), and adaptive (refined by the merging procedure as generation proceeds). On DL3DV and RealEstate10K, PPMem outperforms prior 3D-grounded world models in video quality while jointly producing metric-scale depth, surface normals, and exportable planar geometry, sustaining coherence across hundreds of frames under large viewpoint changes. Project page: https://hyzcluster.github.io/ppmem.

ru.title: Память мира из плоскостей: компактно, геометрично, согласованно
ru.desc: Авторы представляют PPMem — video world model, которая использует компактные плоскостные примитивы (plane primitives) в качестве постоянной 3D-памяти для генерации длинных согласованных видео. Каждый primitive описывается всего 7 параметрами, что в тысячи раз компактнее облака точек и при этом сохраняет основные структурные элементы сцены: стены, полы и фасады. Модель расширяет video diffusion transformer планарным prediction head и модулем Depth Token Fusion, которые совместно предсказывают RGB-видео и геометрию, а память условирует последующие autoregressive chunks через рендеринг глубины. На DL3DV и RealEstate10K PPMem превосходит аналоги по качеству видео и при этом выдаёт metric-scale глубину, normals и экспортируемую геометрию, сохраняя согласованность на сотнях кадров.

en.title: PPMem: Compact 3D Memory for Coherent Video Generation
en.desc: PPMem is a novel video world model that utilizes compact plane primitives as a form of persistent 3D memory to create long, coherent videos with clear geometric structures. By employing a video diffusion transformer enhanced with a planar prediction head and a Depth Token Fusion module, PPMem generates both RGB video and planar geometry simultaneously. This approach allows for a highly efficient memory system that is significantly smaller than traditional point clouds, while still maintaining geometric accuracy and consistency across different views. The model demonstrates superior performance in video quality and depth prediction on benchmark datasets, making it a powerful tool for generating realistic 3D environments.

zh.title: PPMem：高效的视频世界模型
zh.desc: PPMem是一种视频世界模型，利用紧凑的平面原语作为持久的3D记忆，生成长时间一致的视频，并具有明确的度量几何特征。它通过引入平面预测头和深度标记融合模块，增强了视频扩散变换器，使得每个自回归片段能够共同生成RGB视频和平面几何。PPMem的记忆结构比每像素点云紧凑三个数量级，能够在大视角变化下保持一致性，并且在DL3DV和RealEstate10K数据集上表现优于之前的3D基础世界模型。该模型不仅生成高质量的视频，还同时输出度量尺度的深度、表面法线和可导出的平面几何。

papers.title: Consistent Distribution Matching for Data-Free Diffusion Distillation
papers.abstract: Abstract Consistent Distribution Matching accelerates diffusion and flow models via simulation-free, data-free distillation that unifies generation and score estimation, achieving strong one-step and few-step results.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Flow and diffusion models suffer from slow inference due to computationally expensive numerical integration. Distillation provides a promising way for a student model to learn from a teacher's dynamics, enabling one-step or few-step generation. However, existing methods often depend on curated distillation datasets, costly teacher rollouts, or auxiliary proxy networks, which complicate model training and scaling. In this work, we propose Consistent Distribution Matching, a simulation-free and data-free distillation method for accelerating diffusion and flow models while preserving strong generative capacity. Our key insight is to unify sample generation and score estimation with one student network. Thus, our framework uses only two models, a frozen teacher and a trainable student, and optimizes one objective. We prove that minimizing our objective indicates Wasserstein convergence of the student flow-map pushforwards to the teacher marginals. On ImageNet 256times256, our method attains an FID of 2.04 with a single function evaluation (1-NFE) and a 4-NFE FID of 1.37 within 40 epochs of training, surpassing the state-of-the-art distillation baselines without data. Our code code and model are available at https://consistentdmd.github.io/.

ru.title: Быстрая генерация без данных: одна сеть вместо целого конвейера
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод Consistent Distribution Matching, который ускоряет diffusion и flow модели за счёт дистилляции без симуляции и без данных. Ключевая идея в том, что одна student-сеть одновременно генерирует сэмплы и оценивает score, поэтому используется всего две модели (замороженный teacher и обучаемый student) и одна целевая функция. Авторы доказывают, что минимизация этой функции ведёт к сходимости по Вассерштейну pushforward-распределений flow-map student-модели к маргиналам teacher. На ImageNet 256x256 метод достигает FID 2.04 при одном вызове функции (1-NFE) и FID 1.37 при 4-NFE, превосходя существующие baseline-методы дистилляции без данных.

en.title: Accelerating Generative Models with Unified Distillation
en.desc: This paper introduces Consistent Distribution Matching, a novel method that enhances diffusion and flow models by allowing them to generate data without needing extensive simulations or datasets. The approach simplifies the training process by using a single student network that learns from a frozen teacher model, thus unifying the tasks of sample generation and score estimation. By minimizing a specific objective, the student model can effectively approximate the teacher's distribution, leading to improved performance in generating high-quality samples. The results demonstrate significant advancements in efficiency and quality, achieving state-of-the-art metrics on ImageNet with minimal computational resources.

zh.title: 一致性分布匹配：加速生成模型的创新方法
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为一致性分布匹配的方法，用于加速扩散和流模型的生成过程。该方法通过无模拟和无数据的蒸馏，统一了样本生成和评分估计，从而提高了生成效率。与传统方法不同，我们的方法只需要一个可训练的学生模型和一个冻结的教师模型，简化了模型训练过程。实验结果表明，在ImageNet数据集上，我们的方法在生成质量上超过了现有的蒸馏基线，展示了强大的生成能力。

papers.title: Dusting the Phantom: Gaussian Allocation for Fading Dynamic Content
papers.abstract: Abstract Dynamic Gaussian representations are improved by allocating primitives based on predicted spatiotemporal destinations rather than current locations, recovering small fast-moving objects and fine textures.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Dynamic Gaussian representations have made high-quality, real-time volumetric video increasingly practical, yet challenging motion can still break their reconstruction: small fast-moving objects may disappear, and fine textures in highly dynamic regions are often lost. In particular, simply training longer or using more Gaussians may still fail to recover small, fast-moving objects. We argue that the key bottleneck is not representational capacity itself, but where and when Gaussian primitives are allocated. Existing allocation strategies rely on current Gaussian locations and often overlook the spatiotemporal destinations of relocated Gaussians. To address these limitations, we introduce two complementary strategies. First, Seed Injection identifies under-reconstructed dynamic regions using temporal appearance changes and reconstruction errors, and initializes new Gaussians at geometrically plausible 3D locations through multi-view observations, independent of existing Gaussian locations. Second, Temporal Biased Relocation uses time-resolved optimization signals to guide the spatiotemporal placement of relocated Gaussians. Both strategies maintain a fixed Gaussian budget without modifying the underlying representation. Experiments across multiple dynamic-scene datasets demonstrate improved reconstruction quality, particularly in highly dynamic regions, recovering small, rapidly moving objects and fine-grained appearance details.
affiliations: Pohang University of Science and Technology (POSTECH)

ru.title: Важно не сколько Gaussian-примитивов, а где и когда их разместить
ru.desc: Статья посвящена улучшению динамических Gaussian-представлений для объемного видео в реальном времени, которые плохо восстанавливают маленькие быстро движущиеся объекты и мелкие текстуры. Авторы утверждают, что ключевая проблема — не ёмкость представления, а то, где и когда размещаются Gaussian-примитивы, поскольку существующие стратегии аллокации опираются на текущие позиции и не учитывают пространственно-временные места назначения. Предложены два дополняющих метода: Seed Injection, которая создаёт новые Gaussian-примитивы в геометрически правдоподобных 3D-точках по многовидовым наблюдениям, и Temporal Biased Relocation, которая использует временные сигналы оптимизации для направленного перемещения примитивов. Оба подхода сохраняют фиксированный бюджет Gaussian-примитивов без изменения базового представления и показывают улучшение качества реконструкции в динамичных областях на нескольких датасетах.

en.title: Predicting Future Positions for Better Object Reconstruction
en.desc: This paper presents enhancements to Dynamic Gaussian representations by focusing on the allocation of Gaussian primitives based on predicted future positions instead of their current locations. The authors identify that traditional methods struggle with reconstructing small, fast-moving objects and fine textures in dynamic scenes. They propose two innovative strategies: Seed Injection, which initializes new Gaussians in promising 3D locations based on temporal changes, and Temporal Biased Relocation, which optimizes the placement of Gaussians over time. These methods improve the reconstruction quality in challenging scenarios while maintaining a fixed number of Gaussians.

zh.title: 优化高斯表示，提升动态场景重建质量
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种改进的动态高斯表示方法，通过基于预测的时空目标位置而非当前位置信息来分配高斯原语，从而更好地恢复小型快速移动物体和细腻纹理。现有的分配策略往往忽视了重新定位高斯的时空目标，导致在动态场景中重建质量下降。我们引入了两种互补策略：种子注入和时间偏置重定位，以优化高斯的分配位置。实验结果表明，这些方法在多个动态场景数据集上显著提高了重建质量，尤其是在高度动态的区域。

papers.title: Sparse Autoencoders Are a Shared Coordinate System for Symbolic Matching
papers.abstract: Abstract SAE-IDF matches symbolic units across heterogeneous systems using sparse autoencoders and rarity-weighted features, enabling scalable neuro-symbolic reasoning.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Large language models (LLMs) hold broad knowledge in one set of weights, but lack interpretability and trustworthy reasoning, especially in high-stakes use cases. A neuro-symbolic model, with its interpretable architecture and System 2 reasoning capacity, is a promising alternative if built at the scale of LLMs; however, its symbolic backbone is usually constructed with human effort, so existing neuro-symbolic models are bottlenecked by the scope of the symbol component and usually domain-specific. A data-driven method could instead build a larger symbolic system by aligning and merging existing ones. We target its first, foundational step: matching units across these heterogeneous systems. Our method, SAE-IDF, encodes a symbol in its native context into a sparse code with a sparse autoencoder (SAE), re-weights each dimension by its rarity and matches across systems. On 12 tasks across 6 kinds of symbolic system, SAE-IDF outperforms the same LLM's dense baseline on all tasks with Gemma-2-9B and all but one with Llama-3.1-8B, by up to 45 points, consistently across SAE layers and configurations. SAE-IDF is also interpretable: every dimension of the sparse code has a human-readable meaning, so each match decomposes into named concepts (features). Our work paves the way to a universal symbolic backbone.

ru.title: Единый символьный фундамент для нейросимволического ИИ через разреженные признаки
ru.desc: В статье предлагается метод SAE-IDF, который сопоставляет символьные единицы из разнородных символьных систем, например онтологий и баз знаний. Каждый символ кодируется в свой исходный контекст с помощью разреженного автоэнкодера (SAE), после чего каждое измерение разреженного кода взвешивается по редкости. Метод превосходит плотный baseline той же LLM (Gemma-2-9B и Llama-3.1-8B) на 12 задачах из 6 типов символьных систем, с улучшением до 45 пунктов. Важным свойством подхода является интерпретируемость: каждое измерение кода имеет понятный человеку смысл, поэтому сопоставление раскладывается на именованные концепты.

en.title: Building a Universal Symbolic Backbone with SAE-IDF
en.desc: The paper introduces SAE-IDF, a method that uses sparse autoencoders to match symbolic units from different systems, enhancing neuro-symbolic reasoning. This approach addresses the limitations of large language models (LLMs) by providing a more interpretable and trustworthy reasoning framework. By encoding symbols in their original context and re-weighting them based on rarity, SAE-IDF successfully aligns and merges symbolic systems without heavy human intervention. The results show significant performance improvements across various tasks, demonstrating the potential for creating a universal symbolic backbone for AI applications.

zh.title: 构建可解释的神经符号推理系统
zh.desc: 本文提出了一种名为SAE-IDF的方法，用于在异构系统之间匹配符号单元，利用稀疏自编码器和稀有性加权特征，从而实现可扩展的神经符号推理。当前的大型语言模型虽然知识广泛，但缺乏可解释性和可信的推理能力，尤其在高风险应用中表现不佳。SAE-IDF通过将符号编码为稀疏代码，并根据稀有性重新加权每个维度，成功在12个任务中超越了同一大型语言模型的密集基线。该方法不仅提高了性能，还具备可解释性，使得每个匹配都可以分解为可读的概念。

papers.title: DuET: Note-Frame Dual Encoding for Piano Performance-to-Score Transcription
papers.abstract: Abstract DuET is a dual-encoder transformer that jointly performs MIDI-to-score transcription and beat tracking to improve timing and duration accuracy in piano performance transcription.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Transcribing expressive piano performances into scores requires interpreting individual note timings within an underlying metrical structure. However, score attributes are associated with notes, whereas beats may occur without coincident note onsets. We introduce DuET, a Dual-Encoder Transformer that jointly learns note-level performance MIDI-to-score (PM2S) transcription and frame-level beat and downbeat tracking. Bidirectional cross-attention connects note and frame encoders, while an autoregressive decoder alternates between their representations to predict structured score attributes. We further introduce TimeRoPE and Time-Pitch Rotary Positional Encoding (TPRoPE) to establish a shared performance-time reference and explicitly encode relative temporal and pitch relationships. Evaluations on ASAP, a classical piano dataset, and our curated Gangqinpu dataset, which spans multiple genres with a focus on popular piano music, demonstrate improvements in score timing and notated duration. Compared with the strongest baseline on each dataset, DuET reduces MUSTER mean error from 6.56% to 3.64% on Gangqinpu and from 11.30% to 11.22% on ASAP. Ablations support the benefits of frame-level context, time-based positional encoding, and decoder-history masking. Code, weights, and demos are available at https://github.com/wei-zeng98/DuET.
affiliations: Integrative Sciences and Engineering Programme, NUS Graduate School
School of Computing, National University of Singapore

ru.title: Нота встречается с ритмом: точная транскрипция фортепиано
ru.desc: DuET — это dual-encoder transformer, который одновременно решает две задачи: транскрипцию MIDI в нотную запись (PM2S) на уровне нот и отслеживание битов и долей на уровне фреймов. Два энкодера связаны двунаправленным cross-attention, а autoregressive decoder по очереди опирается на их представления, предсказывая структурированные атрибуты нот. Авторы вводят TimeRoPE и TPRoPE, чтобы задать общую временную шкалу исполнения и явно кодировать относительные временные и тональные связи. На датасетах ASAP и Gangqinpu модель снижает ошибку по метрике MUSTER, что улучшает точность временных меток и длительностей нот.

en.title: Transforming Piano Performance with DuET: Accurate Transcription and Beat Tracking
en.desc: DuET is a dual-encoder transformer designed to enhance the accuracy of MIDI-to-score transcription and beat tracking in piano performances. It utilizes a bidirectional cross-attention mechanism to connect note-level and frame-level encoders, allowing for better interpretation of timing and duration. The model introduces innovative techniques like TimeRoPE and Time-Pitch Rotary Positional Encoding to effectively manage temporal and pitch relationships. Evaluations show that DuET significantly reduces transcription errors compared to existing methods, demonstrating its effectiveness across various piano music genres.

zh.title: DuET：提升钢琴演奏转录准确性的双编码器变换器
zh.desc: DuET是一种双编码器变换器，旨在同时进行MIDI到乐谱的转录和节拍跟踪，以提高钢琴演奏转录的时序和持续时间准确性。该模型通过双向交叉注意力机制连接音符和帧编码器，并使用自回归解码器交替处理它们的表示，以预测结构化的乐谱属性。我们还引入了时间旋转位置编码（TimeRoPE）和时间音高旋转位置编码（TPRoPE），以建立共享的演奏时间参考，并明确编码相对的时间和音高关系。实验结果表明，DuET在多个数据集上显著降低了乐谱时序和标记持续时间的误差。

papers.title: GeoState: Learning View-Decoupled Geometry States for 3D World Modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract GeoState introduces a view-independent geometric representation that separates scene dynamics from camera motion for predictive 3D world modeling, enabling consistent multi-view forecasting and cross-dataset generalization.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Recent 3D world models increasingly use features from geometry foundation models (GFMs) as predictive world states, benefiting from their rich geometric priors. However, the view dependence of these features entangles scene dynamics with camera-induced variation, making the resulting state evolution harder to predict. We propose GeoState, a view-decoupled geometry representation for predictive 3D world modeling that separates scene-state evolution from camera-dependent observation. Specifically, a scene tokenizer aggregates multi-view GFM features into a view-decoupled scene state, which a geometry decoder queries using camera rays. An autoregressive world model then predicts future scene states, while camera motion is modeled separately. The predicted states can therefore be decoded under either predicted or externally specified cameras, while retaining a single context-derived scale throughout the rollout without per-frame scale alignment. Experiments show that GeoState outperforms prior 3D world models on Waymo, supports geometrically consistent cross-view querying, and generalizes zero-shot to KITTI and nuScenes. Project page: https://hongchang-liu.github.io/GeoState-project-page/
affiliations: Guangdong Laboratory of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Economy (SZ)

ru.title: Отделяем динамику мира от взгляда камеры для согласованного 3D-прогнозирования
ru.desc: Статья представляет GeoState — представление геометрии сцены, не зависящее от точки обзора камеры, которое отделяет динамику сцены от движения камеры. Scene tokenizer агрегирует признаки geometry foundation models с нескольких видов в view-decoupled состояние сцены, а geometry decoder извлекает геометрию по лучам камеры. Autoregressive world model предсказывает будущие состояния сцены, а движение камеры моделируется отдельно, что обеспечивает единый масштаб на всём rollout без выравнивания по кадрам. Эксперименты показывают превосходство над предыдущими 3D world models на Waymo и zero-shot обобщение на KITTI и nuScenes.

en.title: Decoupling Scene Dynamics from Camera Motion for Better 3D Predictions
en.desc: GeoState presents a novel geometric representation that distinguishes between the dynamics of a scene and the motion of the camera, enhancing predictive modeling of 3D environments. By utilizing features from geometry foundation models (GFMs), it creates a view-independent scene state that simplifies the prediction of future states. This approach allows for consistent multi-view forecasting and enables the model to generalize across different datasets without being affected by camera variations. The results demonstrate that GeoState significantly improves performance on benchmark datasets while maintaining geometric consistency across views.

zh.title: GeoState：解耦视角的3D世界建模新方法
zh.desc: GeoState提出了一种独立于视角的几何表示方法，能够将场景动态与相机运动分离，从而实现预测性的3D世界建模。这种方法利用几何基础模型（GFM）的特征，生成一致的多视角预测，并支持跨数据集的泛化。通过场景标记器将多视角GFM特征聚合为视角解耦的场景状态，进而使用几何解码器进行查询。实验结果表明，GeoState在Waymo数据集上表现优于以往的3D世界模型，并且能够在KITTI和nuScenes数据集上实现零样本泛化。

papers.title: AI-Driven Disaster Response and Displacement Monitoring
papers.abstract: Abstract  ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE (AI) has demonstrated its potential across a wide range of humanitarian tasks, offering scalable and data-driven solutions to some of the world's most pressing challenges. For instance, in addressing climate change, AI-powered models are being used for faster and more accurate global weather forecasting, control and design of renewable energy, and monitoring deforestation. Machine learning algorithms analyze satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and promote sustainable development. AI has also transformed disaster response and conflict monitoring, providing innovative solutions for assessing damage and urgent needs and tracking displacement.

ru.title: AI на службе человечества: данные помогают решать глобальные проблемы
ru.desc: Статья рассматривает применение AI в гуманитарных задачах, где модели машинного обучения дают масштабируемые решения на основе данных. В сфере борьбы с изменением климата LLM и другие AI-модели используются для более быстрого и точного прогноза погоды, управления и проектирования возобновляемой энергетики, а также мониторинга вырубки лесов. Алгоритмы анализируют спутниковые снимки и социально-экономические данные, чтобы предсказывать уровень бедности и поддерживать устойчивое развитие. Кроме того, AI улучшает реагирование на катастрофы и мониторинг конфликтов, помогая оценивать ущерб, определять срочные потребности и отслеживать перемещение людей.

en.title: Harnessing AI for Humanitarian Solutions
en.desc: This paper discusses the impactful role of artificial intelligence (AI) in addressing humanitarian challenges. It highlights how machine learning models enhance global weather forecasting and optimize renewable energy solutions to combat climate change. Additionally, the paper emphasizes the use of AI in analyzing satellite imagery and socioeconomic data to predict poverty and support sustainable development. Furthermore, it explores AI's contributions to disaster response and conflict monitoring, improving damage assessment and tracking of displaced populations.

zh.title: 人工智能助力人道主义挑战的解决方案
zh.desc: 人工智能（AI）在许多人道主义任务中展现了其潜力，提供可扩展和数据驱动的解决方案来应对全球最紧迫的挑战。例如，在应对气候变化方面，AI模型被用于更快速和准确的全球天气预报、可再生能源的控制与设计，以及监测森林砍伐。机器学习算法分析卫星图像和社会经济数据，以预测贫困并促进可持续发展。AI还改变了灾难响应和冲突监测，为评估损失、紧急需求和追踪流离失所提供了创新解决方案。

papers.title: Librarian Agents: Training LLMs to Curate Long-Context Workspaces that Anticipate Future Queries
papers.abstract: Abstract Librarian Agents use reinforcement learning to train builder agents that reorganize document corpora into reusable hierarchical workspaces, improving downstream reasoning accuracy and amortizing costs across queries.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Reasoning over long document contexts remains a challenge for large language models (LLMs). Standard retrieval methods are inherently reactive, bottlenecking agents with complex, cross-document reasoning at inference time, while precomputed structures like knowledge graphs often fall short because they rely on rigid heuristics. Instead, can we allow agents to perform anticipatory directed curation: learning to proactively reorganize unstructured corpora prior to inference to efficiently serve diverse future queries. We build on a key asymmetry in modern agentic harnesses (e.g., Claude Code): while LLM agents are adept at navigating existing filesystems to solve an immediate task, they are rarely trained to construct reusable workspaces for future use. To instantiate this capability, we introduce Librarian Agents, a framework in which a builder agent transforms raw documents into a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and reference links, which forms a workspace tailored for a downstream answering agent. We formulate workspace construction as a Markov decision process and optimize the builder policy via reinforcement learning to directly maximize downstream answering accuracy. Empirically, Librarian Agents outperforms the strongest retrieval and precomputation baselines by 33 percentage points on BrowseComp-Plus, amortizes upfront construction costs across repeated queries, and generalizes zero-shot to unseen domains on BRIGHT with a 31-point average accuracy improvement.

ru.title: Пусть агент сам наводит порядок в документах заранее, а не ищет их на лету
ru.desc: Авторы предлагают Librarian Agents: агент-строитель с помощью reinforcement learning превращает сырые документы в иерархическую файловую систему с синтетическими файлами и ссылками. Такая рабочая среда заранее подготавливается под будущие запросы, а не ищется реактивно во время inference. Задача построения формализована как Markov decision process, а политика оптимизируется напрямую по точности ответов downstream-агента. В экспериментах подход опережает сильнейшие baseline по retrieval и precomputation на 33 п.п. на BrowseComp-Plus, а на BRIGHT показывает zero-shot генерализацию с ростом точности в среднем на 31 п.п.

en.title: Revolutionizing Document Organization with Librarian Agents
en.desc: This paper introduces Librarian Agents, which utilize reinforcement learning to train builder agents that reorganize document collections into structured workspaces. This proactive approach allows for better reasoning accuracy in large language models by anticipating future queries and preparing the data accordingly. The workspace is created as a hierarchical filesystem of synthetic files and links, optimizing the retrieval process for downstream tasks. The results show significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency compared to traditional retrieval methods and precomputed structures.

zh.title: 图书管理员代理：提升文档重组与推理准确性
zh.desc: 本论文介绍了一种名为图书管理员代理的框架，利用强化学习训练构建代理，将文档集合重新组织为可重用的层次工作空间，从而提高下游推理的准确性。传统的检索方法在处理复杂的跨文档推理时存在瓶颈，而知识图谱等预计算结构往往依赖于固定的启发式方法，效果有限。通过允许代理进行前瞻性的定向整理，论文提出了一种主动重组非结构化文档的方法，以高效服务于未来多样化的查询。实验结果表明，图书管理员代理在多个基准测试中显著优于传统方法，且在未见领域中也能实现准确性的提升。

papers.title: GlobeBench: Evaluating Text-Based World Model Capabilities for Scalable Environment Simulations
papers.abstract: Abstract GlobeBench introduces a standardized benchmark of 1,632 tasks across five domains to evaluate text-based world models, revealing that current LLMs struggle with propagating action effects across dependent objects.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Text-based world models have recently shown potential to simulate complex RL environment state transitions for a diverse set of use cases. However, no standardized benchmark exists to compare, study and improve these models. Through this paper, we attempt to solve this problem by building GlobeBench, a novel benchmark with 1,632 tasks across five separate domains and nineteen simulation skills. The tasks check whether models can predict the environment's response to a specific action given the full agent trajectory by understanding earlier state changes, following environment rules, and predicting the effects of actions on both related and unrelated objects. We compare the predicted environment response with an execution-derived reference, using a hybrid architecture with both deterministic gates and a semantic judge. Among 20 general-purpose LLMs and specialized text world models, GPT-6 Astra achieves the highest task success rate at 49.57%. We find that model accuracy decreases as actions affect a larger portion of the environment. Specifically, when the agent's changes must propagate to dependent objects, task success drops to an average of 5.1% across all 20 models. Although model strengths differ across tasks, 631 tasks remain unsolved by any model, suggesting a significant gap in general LLM capabilities as a world model.

ru.title: Модели мира на LLM пока не умеют учитывать цепочку последствий действий
ru.desc: Статья представляет GlobeBench — стандартизированный бенчмарк из 1 632 задач в пяти доменах, предназначенный для оценки текстовых world models, которые предсказывают изменения состояния среды (RL-окружения) после действий агента. Оценка проводится гибридно: детерминированные проверки сочетаются с семантическим LLM-судьёй, который сравнивает предсказание с эталоном, полученным при реальном исполнении. Среди 20 моделей лучший результат показала GPT-6 Astra с успешностью 49,57%, но точность падает, когда действия влияют на зависимые объекты, — в среднем до 5,1%. Авторы делают вывод, что 631 задача не решена ни одной моделью, что указывает на существенный пробел в способности общих LLM выступать в роли world model.

en.title: Benchmarking the Limits of Text-Based World Models
en.desc: GlobeBench is a new benchmark designed to evaluate text-based world models through 1,632 tasks across five domains. It highlights that current large language models (LLMs) struggle to accurately predict the effects of actions on dependent objects in a simulated environment. The benchmark assesses models on their ability to understand state changes and follow environmental rules, revealing that accuracy drops significantly when actions impact multiple objects. Despite some models performing better than others, a large number of tasks remain unsolved, indicating a critical gap in the capabilities of existing LLMs as world models.

zh.title: GlobeBench：评估文本世界模型的新基准
zh.desc: GlobeBench 是一个标准化的基准测试，包含 1,632 个任务，涵盖五个领域，用于评估基于文本的世界模型。研究发现，当前的大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理依赖对象的动作效果传播时存在困难。通过构建 GlobeBench，我们能够比较、研究和改进这些模型的性能。结果显示，尽管 GPT-6 Astra 在任务成功率上表现最佳，但在需要动作影响多个对象时，模型的准确性显著下降。

papers.title: Relational Learning as World Modeling
papers.abstract: Abstract  Relational learning typically predicts from a database state, but decision making asks a different question: how will that state change under an action? In operational systems, the answer depends on system-specific dynamics that may not be visible in the database itself. We view each such system as a relational "world" and ask whether a model can infer how it behaves from observed executions. We introduce TabWM (Tabular World Model) and WorldRel, a generator of executable relational worlds for pretraining. Given executions from an unseen world, TabWM uses them as context to predict the sparse structured edits caused by a new action without parameter updates. Across 512 held-out worlds, complete-edit F1 rises from 0.016 with no observed executions to 0.685 with 64, where a correct edit must match its operation, relational location, and value. Because these predictions are explicit relational edits, they can be applied recursively to imagine candidate futures and compare actions before they are taken. Broader search over these predicted futures improves the realized return of selected action sequences. Together, these results suggest that relational dynamics can be learned in context, broadening relational learning from modeling system state to modeling how that state changes under action.

ru.title: Модель учится предсказывать, как мир меняется под действием, прямо из контекста
ru.desc: Статья представляет TabWM (Tabular World Model) и набор синтетических реляционных миров WorldRel для предобучения. Модель учится предсказывать, как действие меняет состояние базы данных, по нескольким наблюдённым выполнениям в той же системе, без обновления параметров (in-context learning). Точность полных правок (F1) растёт с 0.016 до 0.685 при увеличении числа примеров до 64. Предсказанные правки можно применять рекурсивно для моделирования будущих состояний и выбора лучших последовательностей действий.

en.title: Predicting Change: Learning Relational Dynamics for Better Decision-Making
en.desc: This paper discusses a new approach to relational learning that focuses on predicting how a system's state changes when actions are taken, rather than just predicting the state itself. The authors introduce TabWM, a model that learns to infer system dynamics from observed executions in relational worlds. By using a generator called WorldRel for pretraining, TabWM can predict structured edits resulting from actions without needing to update its parameters. The results show significant improvements in prediction accuracy, allowing for better decision-making by imagining future states based on these predictions.

zh.title: 学习关系动态，提升决策能力
zh.desc: 关系学习通常是从数据库状态进行预测，但决策制定则关注在某个动作下状态如何变化。我们将每个系统视为一个关系“世界”，并探讨模型是否能够从观察到的执行中推断其行为。我们提出了TabWM（表格世界模型）和WorldRel，一个用于预训练的可执行关系世界生成器。通过对未观察到的世界的执行进行预测，TabWM能够在不更新参数的情况下，预测由新动作引起的稀疏结构编辑，从而实现更好的决策支持。

papers.title: What It Is, Not What It Says: Securing Agentic Browsing Interactions with Web Semantics
papers.abstract: Abstract Intact protects AI web agents by isolating webpage elements via provenance-aware representations and enforcing capability-bound execution with user consent for third-party actions.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small AI agents increasingly browse the web on users' behalf, yet they consume webpages as screenshots or text, exposing their LLMs to unvetted third-party content. Browsers enforce semantics under which what an element can do depends on what it is and where it comes from, not on what it says. Agents flatten these semantics, so injected text can persuade the LLM to exercise the user's authority for content that has none. As LLMs remain easy to persuade, the agent's interface to the web must itself ensure the integrity of what the agent reads, interprets, and does. We propose Intact, which runs on an unmodified browser. Intact builds GenTree, a bespoke representation that captures provenance and web semantics. Intact passes the page via GenTree to the LLM one element at a time, so the LLM decides on each element without any other element's text. Its harness executes each step only within the capabilities of the step's element and asks the user before acting on third-party content. On 1,270 real webpages, GenTree attributes 2.3x as many elements to third parties as the browser, which misattributes 58.7% of them to the first party. On 1,091 of these webpages with injected attacks, only 12.8% of attacks get through Intact's planner, each at most as a consent request, against 73.1% for a conventional planner. Isolation disrupts functionality on only 3.7% of tasks, and a parallel schedule could remove most of its added latency.

ru.title: Доверяй элементу, а не тексту: изоляция веб-контента защищает AI-агентов от подмены
ru.desc: Статья представляет Intact — систему защиты для AI-агентов, которые просматривают веб от имени пользователя и уязвимы к prompt injection со стороны сторонного контента. Ключевая идея — представление GenTree, которое сохраняет провенанс (происхождение) элементов страницы и их веб-семантику, в отличие от браузера, который часто неверно относит элементы к первой стороне. LLM обрабатывает страницу поэлементно, без влияния текста других элементов, а исполнение действий ограничивается возможностями конкретного элемента с запросом согласия пользователя на действия со сторонним контентом. Эксперименты на 1270 реальных страницах и 1091 странице с атаками показывают, что успешных атак проходит 12,8% против 73,1% у обычного планировщика, при этом функциональность нарушается лишь в 3,7% задач.

en.title: Intact: Safeguarding AI Agents with Provenance-Aware Web Interaction
en.desc: The paper introduces Intact, a system designed to protect AI web agents by isolating webpage elements and ensuring safe interactions with third-party content. It utilizes a representation called GenTree, which captures the origin and semantics of web elements, allowing the AI to process each element independently. This method prevents malicious content from misleading the AI into executing unauthorized actions by requiring user consent for third-party interactions. The results show that Intact significantly reduces the risk of attacks while maintaining functionality for most tasks.

zh.title: 保护AI代理，确保网页安全
zh.desc: 这篇论文介绍了Intact，一个保护AI网页代理的系统。它通过使用基于来源的表示来隔离网页元素，并在用户同意的情况下执行第三方操作。Intact构建了GenTree，这是一种定制的表示方法，可以捕捉网页的来源和语义。通过逐个元素地将网页传递给大型语言模型（LLM），Intact确保了LLM在处理每个元素时不会受到其他元素文本的影响，从而提高了安全性。

papers.title: ARC-SORT: Adaptive, Robust, Compensated Multi-Object Tracking with Interacting Multiple Models
papers.abstract: Abstract ARC-SORT improves multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts by using adaptive uncertainty-based search regions, corrective identity swaps, and appearance-only re-identification to achieve high accuracy with minimal identity switches.  Generated by thinkingmachines/Inkling-Small Multi-object tracking in sports broadcasts is hard for two reasons: athletes move fast and change direction abruptly, and the camera pans and zooms at the same time. We present ARC-SORT (Adaptive, Robust, Compensated SORT), a tracking-by-detection tracker that trains nothing and runs in real time. Its design rule: the tracker measures its own uncertainty, and that measurement decides how it acts. An Interacting Multiple Model (IMM) Kalman filter gives every track a predictive covariance, and we turn it into a per-track search region: the less reliable the motion prediction, the larger the region in which a detection may match (uncertainty-adaptive Expansion IoU, EIoU). On identical inputs, this continuous coupling is what matters: the same covariance used as a hard Mahalanobis gate hurts at every threshold we swept, and richer covariance summaries add nothing measurable. When two tracks cross, the assignment cost itself reports whether the decision was close. ARC-SORT keeps such pairs under review and applies at most one corrective identity swap once post-crossing appearance evidence shows the first decision was wrong; this adds +1.0 HOTA (higher order tracking accuracy) on both the SportsMOT and DanceTrack test sets at under a millisecond per frame. For players who leave the frame for seconds, motion extrapolation carries no information, so our offline re-identification drops the usual motion gate and links tracklets by appearance alone. ARC-SORT reaches 81.82 HOTA on the SportsMOT test set with the fewest identity switches of the 69 leaderboard entries as of August 2026 and tied-third multi-object tracking accuracy (MOTA, 97.09), and 62.1 HOTA on DanceTrack test with the same association settings. On Deep-EIoU's public detections and embeddings it reaches 80.31 HOTA, +3.1 over Deep-EIoU. It runs at about 50 frames per second on a laptop RTX 3060 GPU. Code will be released.

ru.title: Трекер, который сам оценивает свою неуверенность и действует по ней
ru.desc: В статье представлен ARC-SORT — трекер для отслеживания нескольких объектов в спортивных трансляциях, который не требует обучения и работает в реальном времени. Ключевая идея: трекер оценивает собственную неопределённость через IMM Kalman filter и на её основе задаёт адаптивную область поиска для сопоставления детекций (Expansion IoU). При пересечении траекторий система сохраняет спорные случаи и делает не более одной корректирующей замены идентичности по данным внешнего вида, что повышает HOTA. Для офлайн-переидентификации игроков, пропавших из кадра, используется только appearance-based связывание без motion gate. Метод достигает state-of-the-art результатов на SportsMOT и DanceTrack при скорости около 50 кадров в секунду.

en.title: Adaptive Tracking for Accurate Sports Broadcasts
en.desc: ARC-SORT is a new method for tracking multiple objects in sports broadcasts, designed to handle the challenges of fast-moving athletes and dynamic camera movements. It uses an adaptive uncertainty-based approach to define search regions, allowing for more accurate tracking by adjusting to the reliability of motion predictions. The method incorporates corrective identity swaps to minimize identity switches when tracks cross, enhancing overall tracking accuracy. With impressive performance metrics, ARC-SORT achieves high tracking accuracy while running in real-time, making it suitable for live sports analysis.

zh.title: ARC-SORT：体育直播中的高效多目标跟踪
zh.desc: ARC-SORT是一种用于体育直播中的多目标跟踪方法，采用自适应的不确定性搜索区域和纠正身份交换技术，以实现高精度和最小身份切换。该方法通过检测跟踪，实时运行，无需训练，利用卡尔曼滤波器为每个轨迹提供预测协方差，并根据不确定性调整搜索区域。ARC-SORT在运动员快速移动和摄像机变焦的情况下，能够有效处理轨迹交叉问题，并在出现错误时进行身份纠正。该方法在多个测试集上表现出色，达到了高阶跟踪精度（HOTA）和多目标跟踪精度（MOTA）的领先水平。
